supports http with nodejs should able to: harness limitation, root-caused (plan.md phase 2, investigate item): axios.CancelToken (the legacy top-level class/static) is not part of this package's public API - deliberately dropped in the API trim (axios itself deprecates it in favour of AbortSignal; this package's shape-level config.cancelToken support - AxiosCancelTokenLike, resolveSignal in axios-request.adapter.ts - is untouched). Strategy (a) shims axios's whole default export with this package's own axiosRef (adapters/axiosref-instance.mjs), which has no .CancelToken static, so `axios.CancelToken.source()` throws a synchronous TypeError ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'source')") before a single request or server interaction happens - deterministic in every environment (confirmed with an isolated repro against the built package with no server/timing involved at all, AND against the real GitHub Actions job log for this exact test, 2026-09-26, run #16 'axios (axiosRef as the instance)' - same TypeError, same line). The 'passes locally, fails on every Actions run' premise doesn't hold under the current code: it fails identically everywhere. Strategy (b) - the real axios package, only its transport adapter swapped - has no expected-failure entry for this test at all (axios.CancelToken there is real axios's own class), confirming this package's actual multi-request cancelToken cancellation has no bug; pinned directly with a real shared-cancelToken/synchronous-cancel scenario in tests/axios-compatibility-matrix.e2e.spec.ts ('cancels multiple in-flight requests sharing one cancelToken', differential against @nestjs/axios) and a 20-iteration stress repro.
